title: Surreal Floating Creature
description: A purple one-eyed creature with three legs floats on a small cloud in the center of a swirling vortex sky. Below it, a broken red pathway winds through colorful clouds against a dark, dripping cosmic background with geometric shapes.
prompt: A surreal painting of a purple cyclops creature with three long legs and a sad expression, floating on a small white cloud in the center of a swirling dark vortex. The creature has antennae with colored orbs. Below is a broken glowing red hexagonal pathway winding through layers of teal, purple and orange clouds with black dripping paint effects. Colorful geometric triangles float throughout the chaotic cosmic scene.
